description: This line plot illustrates the relative change across different layer groups for four distinct model configurations, alongside a baseline reference. The x-axis is categorical, displaying five discrete layer groups in sequential order: "Layer1-4", "Layer5-12", "Layer13-20", "Layer21-28", and "Layer29-32". The y-axis represents "Relative Change" on a linear scale, ranging from -15% to 5% with tick marks at 5% intervals. A horizontal dashed grey line remains constant at 0% across the entire x-axis. The solid yellow line with circular markers, representing "LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit", begins near 0% at Layer1-4, dips slightly to approximately -1% at Layer5-12, returns to near 0% at Layer13-20, and ends slightly above 0% at Layer29-32. The solid red line with square markers, denoting "LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit", starts near 0% at Layer1-4, declines to roughly -2.5% at Layer5-12, remains relatively steady through Layer21-28, and rises back to approximately 0% at Layer29-32. The solid light blue line with circular markers, indicating "RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit", starts near 0% at Layer1-4, declines to a low of approximately -6% at Layer13-20, and then rises to end near -1% at Layer29-32. Finally, the solid dark blue line with square markers, representing "RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit", begins at approximately -1% at Layer1-4, experiences a sharp decline to a minimum of roughly -14.5% at Layer13-20, and subsequently increases to end at approximately -1.5% at Layer29-32.
